name: Amendment
description: An amendment to an existing Fontara agreement (sell side): only the paragraphs for what changes print: a term extension, a new annual fee, or a new limitation of liability picked from the Clause Library's pre-approved options (Standard, Acceptable, Fallback). Everything else in the original agreement stays.

fields.label: Liability Position
fields.help: Pick a new limitation of liability only if it changes. Standard: sign. Acceptable: legal operations reviews. Fallback: the furthest Fontara goes, general counsel's approval. Wording from the Clause Library (sell side).

template: This Amendment is made on {{Amendment Effective Date}} between {{Legal Entity}} ("Vendor") and {{Customer Legal Name}}, {{Customer Address}} ("Customer"), and amends the {{Original Agreement}} (the "Agreement").

template.text: Term. The Agreement's term is extended to {{New Expiration Date}}. The renewal and notice provisions apply to the extended term.
Fees. From the Amendment Effective Date the annual fee is {{Currency}} {{New Annual Fee}}, invoiced as the Agreement provides.

Limitation of liability. The Agreement's limitation of liability clause is replaced with: Vendor's aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the prior 3 months. Vendor is not liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, including lost profits, lost data and lost revenue, even if Vendor was advised of the possibility of such loss. Vendor's IP indemnity obligations are subject to the separate cap the Indemnification clause states, and no other claim is excluded from the cap.

Limitation of liability. The Agreement's limitation of liability clause is replaced with: Each party's total aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages including lost profits. Confidentiality breaches, IP infringement, and fraud are excluded from the cap and consequential damages waiver.

Limitation of liability. The Agreement's limitation of liability clause is replaced with: Vendor's aggregate liability is capped at 2 times the fees paid in the prior 12 months. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, except as this clause provides. Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations, for data breaches, under indemnification obligations and for IP infringement is excluded from both the cap and that exclusion of damages. Vendor is liable for direct lost profits caused by service outages that exceed the agreed service level thresholds.

template: Everything else in the Agreement stays in force. If this Amendment and the Agreement conflict, this Amendment governs.
Signed for {{Customer Legal Name}}: {{Customer Signer Name}}
